answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 36795 Country: Bangladesh Title: I have bank loan and now I am paying my monthly installment to make an end. I am repentant not do it in future, is it biased my running prayer? Question: I have bank loan and now I am paying my monthly installment to make an end. I am repentant not do it in future, is it biased my running prayer? Answer ID: 36795 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 357/144/L=1433) If does not have any effect on your worship, but you shall be sinful for paying interest. You should do taubah and istighfar for the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
